# load
as release load release/release.json schema/release.schema.json
load unnamed/unnamed.json schema/release.schema.json
load broken/broken.json schema/release.schema.json
load missing/missing.json schema/release.schema.json
load release/release.json missing/missing.schema.json

# dump
dump @release
dump --sort @release
as none obj
dump @none
as empty arr
dump @empty
as text str a "quoted" word
dump @text
as assets get @release .assets
dump @assets

# pick and without
as safe without @release token
dump @safe
as two pick @release name draft missing
dump @two
as all without @release
equals @release $all
pick @release
pick @empty name
without @text token

# to_codeblock
to_codeblock @two
to_codeblock-tag @two yaml
to_codeblock-tag @two
to_codeblock @text

# from_codeblock
from_codeblock ```json\n{"a": [1, 2]}\n```
from_codeblock \n  ```\n  {"a": [1, 2]}\n  ```  \n
from_codeblock   {"a": [1, 2]}
from_codeblock ```\n0."a":int=1\n```
from_codeblock ```json extra\n1\n```
from_codeblock ```json\nnot a document\n```
from_codeblock ```json {"a":1}```
from_codeblock words
from_codeblock
